label: Order
caption: FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, ET AL. V. ALLIANCE FOR HIPPOCRATIC MEDICINE, ET AL.
text: UPON FURTHER CONSIDERATION of the application of counsel for the applicants, the response, and the reply filed thereto, IT IS ORDERED that the stay issued on April 14, 2023, is hereby extended until 11:59 p.m. (EDT) on Friday, April 21, 2023.
